items.name: Get to the Point 2018
items.information: This is our first year hosting a competition, and we hope that this is the first of many! We will be assigning judges, but don’t worry if you don’t know how to judge. We will be doing a new competitor tutorial, where we will show everyone how to both judge and compete.
